decisions.reason: The modular trommel screen is an evolution of the established BASIC 518 and sits squarely in the firm's core screening expertise, so the firm can read its market feedback and keep improving it.
The AK flail shredder range was upgraded to EU Stage V engines, which shows ongoing in-house development of a core mobile shredding line the firm understands deeply.

The mobile high-speed grinder builds on the firm's shredding knowledge and got its own page in 2019, but the green-waste sibling (Product E) was already withdrawn, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.
The CERON single-shaft pre-shredder generation is presented as setting standards and is documented in real plant installations, which leverages the firm's established stationary shredding competence.
